# Task: build `todo.py`, a tiny command-line to-do list

Work only inside the current directory. Create `todo.py` (Python 3, standard library only).
It stores items as JSON in the file named by the environment variable `TODO_FILE`,
defaulting to `todo.json` next to the script.

Exact command-line contract (another worker is writing tests against it right now, so do not change it):

- `python3 todo.py add "Buy milk"` prints `added 1: Buy milk`. Ids start at 1 and are never reused.
- `python3 todo.py list` prints one line per item, `1 [ ] Buy milk` or `1 [x] Buy milk`, in id order.
  With no items it prints `nothing to do`.
- `python3 todo.py done 1` prints `done 1: Buy milk`. Unknown id: print `no item 7` to stdout and exit with status 1.
- `python3 todo.py remove 1` prints `removed 1: Buy milk`. Unknown id: `no item 7`, exit status 1.
- Any other usage prints a one-line usage message and exits with status 2.

Keep it under 80 lines. No third-party packages. Do not write tests. Finish by running each
command once in a temporary TODO_FILE to prove it works, and reply with a two-line summary.

# Task: write `test_todo.py` for the to-do CLI

Work only inside the current directory. Another worker is building `todo.py` in parallel, so
write the tests from the contract below, not from the code. Use only the standard library
(`unittest` and `subprocess`). Each test must run `python3 todo.py ...` as a subprocess with the
environment variable `TODO_FILE` pointing at a fresh temporary file, and check stdout and the
exit status.

Contract:
- `add "text"` prints `added <id>: <text>`; ids start at 1 and are never reused, even after remove.
- `list` prints `<id> [ ] <text>` or `<id> [x] <text>` per item in id order, or `nothing to do`.
- `done <id>` prints `done <id>: <text>`; unknown id prints `no item <id>` and exits 1.
- `remove <id>` prints `removed <id>: <text>`; unknown id prints `no item <id>` and exits 1.
- Any other usage exits with status 2.

Write at least six focused tests (empty list, add then list, done marks [x], remove, unknown id,
ids never reused). If `todo.py` does not exist yet, still write the file and say so in your
reply; if it exists, run `python3 -m unittest -v` and report the result in two lines.
